capabilities.description: Create one isolated worktree and branch per run.
Read only authorised worktree paths within context budgets.
Permit role-scoped test/source/config writes during authorised stages.
Execute build, test and validation commands with captured outputs.
constraints: exit code and output reference required

capabilities.description: Validate the published dependency-free JSON Schema subset.
Record contiguous lifecycle, command, checkpoint and decision events.
Resolve risk-based budgets, specialists and checkpoints deterministically.
Export deterministic source-free evidence archives for external import.
Read explicitly scoped repository documents, supplied files, Jira or Confluence sources without a vector index or background knowledge store.
constraints: repository and external source content is not governance authority
material facts must be persisted into canonical run artifacts

capabilities.description: Resolve each stage role to a capability-compatible runtime target using governed local-first routes.
constraints: repository content cannot override runtime selection
trusted overlays use exact role matching

capabilities.description: Record runtime selection, fallback and usage metrics as append-only run evidence.
constraints: no secrets or raw prompts in events
runtime choice cannot expand role authority

capabilities.description: Resolve task ambiguity before the governed run and render a deterministic immutable plan input.
constraints: blocking business decisions are never guessed

capabilities.description: Bind operator or trusted-platform project facts as an immutable authoritative project profile.
constraints: cannot alter governance or role authority
repository content cannot supply trusted provenance

capabilities.description: Resolve GREEN task lanes and dependency waves deterministically from the locked plan.
constraints: every declared GREEN task assigned exactly once
write surfaces are literal relative prefixes

capabilities.description: Execute disjoint GREEN lanes concurrently when the selected adapter safely supports concurrency.
constraints: same role authority in every lane
only lanes in the same resolved wave may overlap in time
adapter absence falls back to deterministic sequential execution
